purpose: Post-320 diagnostic. Immutable original 66 stay/move roots, evaluate all in stored order. The t117 case motivated the design and is reported separately as exposed.
parent_first_step: Use the exact recorded moving alternative as first step. A three-step reach can look two additional legal movements ahead, never reverse into already visited cells.
cash: Same current quote for all compared fresh sites. Subtract one nominal average productive turn of expected ground per travel step; clamp by future episode time and expected remaining lifetime. No charge or plant is silently assumed at an unknown plot.
competition: Reject any future landing reachable by a currently visible enemy worker within the same number of moves. First landing is parent's supplied baseline. Ignore future teammate commands which remain unknown; reject occupied teammate destination on the recorded first step. Do not change base action.
coverage: An alternative beyond first landing requires that all non-tree neighboring cells were observed previously by this seat and at least one observation is within 50 steps. Keep baseline immediate choice even if no admissible future site. Record exclusions by reason, actual eligible action counts and outcome changes vs current guard and parent, separately for train/hold/outside legacy panels. Never deploy based solely on historical differences.
